Thanks — Sarah

Subject: INTERNAL: Atlas Commerce — control-plane flap (INC-78321) — ask: credit eval + postmortem

Team — summary and asks:

Summary: Atlas reported 503/504 spike affecting orders ingestion from ~09:10–09:45 PT on 2028-09-21. Customer traces (Drive link) and our preliminary telemetry both show elevated 503s and several gateway TLS handshakes failing to reach the inference runtime for a ~32–38 minute interval. Our SRE sampling indicates a control-plane throttling event followed by a short autoscaler jitter that correlated with increased queueing and prefix eviction.

Initial internal findings (high level):
- Impact window (prelim): 2028-09-21T09:11:00-2028-09-21T09:43:40-07:00 (final window to be validated)
- Error class: gateway 503/504 + transient connection resets
- Affected region: us-west-2 (customer reported us-west endpoints)
- Rough traffic hit: sustained 600–900 rps during spike (customer baseline ~120 rps)

Immediate asks:
1) Karthik — please pull the finalized server-side request logs, sampling traces, and the autoscaler event timeline. We need the final validated impact window and the raw trace bundle for the postmortem. Aim: deliver by EOD today (2028-09-21).
2) Marissa — can you confirm whether this bucket qualifies for standard SLA pro-rata credits under §4.2, and if we should prepare a one-time adjustment? Procurement will need a tentative dollar amount for their review.
3) Priyom — product will be asked to review the proposed postmortem and any compensatory remedies that affect policy (e.g., define if this fits the "degraded at scale" exception vs. standard outage).

Proposed next steps:
- Karthik produces evidence bundle and final window.
- Diego drafts an initial advisory to Atlas confirming the validated window and next steps (includes a proposed credit calculation).
- Marissa and Finance coordinate to provision any credit; keep legal looped if contract language requires an exception.

Related: hubspot record and incident link above. Evidence attachments include: gateway_error_trace.zip, error_log_bundle.tar.gz (we will upload the server-side bundle to the Drive link).

I want to get ahead of this with a speedy postmortem so Atlas has what they need for procurement. If anyone expects a longer timeline for the evidence pull, flag now.

Diego
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
